title: Eliesen et al. 2024 ex vivo term-placenta tofacitinib concentration observations
citation: Eliesen GAM, Fransen M, van Hove H, van den Broek PHH, Greupink R. Placental transfer of tofacitinib in the ex vivo dual-side human placenta perfusion model. Current Research in Toxicology. 2024;6:100149. doi:10.1016/j.crtox.2024.100149.
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the article

group_summary_diagnostic.method: Arithmetic mean and sample SD of the three placenta-labeled source values at each of ten times, by maternal/fetal compartment; control series excluded because its replicate count is unspecified.

article_reports_at_180_min.source_locator: Primary article Results, tofacitinib paragraph; Fig. 2 caption says mean ± SD, n=3

group_summary_diagnostic.interpretation: The maternal endpoint reproduces the article's rounded summary. The fetal endpoint does not: displayed Table S3 values derive to 25.0 ± 5.0 nM, while the Results report 24.8 ± 4.7 nM. Preserve both source records; do not correct or replace either pending human review.

table_s2_mapping_control.purpose: Independent column-mapping diagnostic using the companion antipyrine table in the same DOCX.

public_dataset_route_screen.publisher_data_availability: Data will be made available on request.

observed_quantity.time_is: elapsed ex vivo perfusion assay time; not gestational age or developmental time
compartments: no-placenta system control; compartment not specified in the table

source_units.source_statement: The article reports three successful cotyledon perfusions from different donors. Supplement Table S3 labels the series only as Placenta 1–3; no personal donor identifiers are included.
source_units.repeated_measure_structure: Each placenta-labeled series contains maternal and fetal concentrations at the ten reported timepoints. Treat repeated rows within a placenta label as one source unit.
source_units.control_series: The no-placenta system-control concentration series has nine numeric values and one N/A at 1 minute. Its replicate count is not stated in the table; do not treat it as a fourth placenta or infer an independent-run count.

missingness.locator: Supplementary Table S3, No placenta in system, 1 min
missingness.recording: Preserved as not_assessed with an empty numeric field; never converted to zero.

eligibility.eligible_for: Source-linked descriptive concentration trajectories, subject to human source/transcription review.
not_eligible_for: Net flux or dimensional transfer-parameter fitting
missing_records: Numerical run-by-time maternal and fetal reservoir volumes
eligibility.article_context: The article says remaining perfusate volumes were estimated at sample times and reports group-level recovery summaries. The inspected article and Supplementary Tables S1–S3 do not provide numerical per-run volume/removal histories or individual recovery rows. Data availability is stated as available on request; no author contact was made.

scope_limits: This is an ex vivo term-placenta transfer observation, not embryo development or an artificial-womb performance result.
The three placenta labels are source labels for repeated measurements, not personal identities.
Do not pool these values with another perfusion study or infer nutrient delivery, embryo health, gestation, birth, or later outcomes.
Source transcription and scientific review remain pending.
